item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Building 102 (former Power House): Building 102's completion is now sourced to Retrofit magazine's Nov 2020 profile of the finished rehabilitation (no completion date given) instead of a 2013 planning packet, and the Port's 2019 memo is described as a schedule, not a completed milestone. The JUUL Labs sublease discussion is dated to the January 2019 Commission meeting, and the map notes now name JUUL Labs as the sublessee per the Port memo. The map notes also say the old Assessor lot 4046001 was retired in 2018, and that the mapped footprint is about four times the building's size per the National Register dimensions.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Building 102 (former Power House): Port staff update to the Commission (memo dated Jan 4, 2019): six of eight buildings complete, Buildings 101 and 102 still under construction, project 100% subleased except two atrium retail spaces; whole-Historic-Core project total costs (not the cost of this building alone) rose from $81.9M at 2014 approvals to $127.0M in Table 2's '2018, Actual' column, while the memo's text gives 'an estimated $125 million at project completion in 2020'; Table 2 marks one line (Building 102's $6.7M) as a future-expenditure estimate (Jan 4, 2019)
item.description: Port staff update to the Commission (memo dated Jan 4, 2019): six of eight buildings complete, Buildings 101 and 102 still under construction, project 100% subleased except two atrium retail spaces; whole-Historic-Core project total costs (not the cost of this building alone) rose from $81.9M at 2014 approvals to $127.0M in Table 2's '2018, Actual' column, while the memo's text gives 'an estimated $125 million at project completion in 2020'; Table 2 marks one line (Building 102's $6.7M) as a future-expenditure estimate (Jan 4, 2019). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2019-01-04.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Building 102 (former Power House): Building abated of PCB electrical equipment; new shipyard electrical service occupies part of the basement; rehabilitation of the remainder under way with completion anticipated in 2019; public disappointment noted that it will be office, not a restaurant (Jan 2019)

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Building 102 (former Power House): Port Commission meeting on JUUL Labs' ten-year sublease of Building 102: attendees ask whether the City can evict JUUL; per Potrero View (Mar 2019), commissioners want to shorten the lease or pass an ordinance, but the Port Director says the Port's hands are tied and the City Attorney is examining JUUL's compliance (~2019)
item.description: Port Commission meeting on JUUL Labs' ten-year sublease of Building 102: attendees ask whether the City can evict JUUL; per Potrero View (Mar 2019), commissioners want to shorten the lease or pass an ordinance, but the Port Director says the Port's hands are tied and the City Attorney is examining JUUL's compliance (~2019). Source: The Potrero View (Rebekah Moan), 2019-03.

item.title: Under construction · Pier 70 Building 102 (former Power House): Master lease approved by the Board of Supervisors and fully executed, giving Orton site control; the Port's January 2019 memo says construction commenced thereafter. The National Trust (Winter 2016 issue) says the rehabilitation 'began this past September' without printing the year, which would be September 2015, while Bisnow (April 2017) says Orton began the redevelopment 'in 2014'; the sources do not agree on the start year (~2015)
item.description: Master lease approved by the Board of Supervisors and fully executed, giving Orton site control; the Port's January 2019 memo says construction commenced thereafter. The National Trust (Winter 2016 issue) says the rehabilitation 'began this past September' without printing the year, which would be September 2015, while Bisnow (April 2017) says Orton began the redevelopment 'in 2014'; the sources do not agree on the start year (~2015). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2019-01-04; National Trust for Historic Preservation (Katherine Flynn), 2016; Bisnow (Julie Littman), 2017-04-19.
